class.name: GodotDoctorValidationCollector
class.brief_description: Base class for collecting and organising validation messages produced during a run. Maintains collections of scene, node, and resource validation results as signals arrive from the active [GodotDoctorRunner] and [GodotDoctorValidator].

method.name: on_started_scene_collection
method.description: Called when a scene collection pass begins; creates a new [GodotDoctorSceneValidationCollection].

method.name: on_finished_scene_collection
method.description: Called when a scene collection pass ends; clears the current node collection.

method.name: on_started_resource_collection
method.description: Called when a resource collection pass begins; creates a new [GodotDoctorResourceValidationCollection].

method.name: on_finished_resource_collection
method.description: Called when a resource collection pass ends.

method.name: on_started_node_collection
method.description: Called when a node collection pass begins; creates a new [GodotDoctorNodeValidationCollection].

method.name: on_finished_node_collection
method.description: Called when a node collection pass ends.

method.name: on_started_run_for_scene_res_path
method.description: Called when validation starts for the scene at [param scene_res_path].

method.name: on_finished_run_for_scene_res_path
method.description: Called when validation finishes for [param _scene_res_path]. Adds the current [GodotDoctorNodeValidationCollection] to the scene collection.

method.name: on_started_run_for_resource
method.description: Called when validation starts for [param resource].

method.name: on_validated_node
method.description: Called when [param node] has been validated; stores [param messages] in the current node collection.

method.name: _get_node_ancestor_path
method.description: Returns a human-readable path string for [param node] by walking up its ancestor chain.

method.name: on_validated_resource
method.description: Called when [param resource] has been validated; stores [param messages] in the current resource collection.

method.name: get_scene_validation_collection
method.description: Returns the current [GodotDoctorSceneValidationCollection], or [code]null[/code] if none exists.

method.name: get_resource_validation_collection
method.description: Returns the current [GodotDoctorResourceValidationCollection], or [code]null[/code] if none exists.

members.member: The resource path of the scene currently being validated.
The scene validation collection being built during the current scene collection pass.
The node validation collection being built during the current node collection pass.
The resource validation collection being built during the current resource collection pass.
